title: Building AI-Powered Apps on Azure
description: Architect a complete AI-powered application using Azure OpenAI, Functions, and Cosmos DB.

data.text: Build an AI customer support chatbot that answers questions from your product documentation. The chatbot should cite sources, handle follow-up questions, and escalate to humans when needed.

Use **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** pattern: embed documentation in **Azure AI Search**, retrieve relevant chunks in **Azure Functions**, and generate responses with **Azure OpenAI**. Store chat history in **Cosmos DB**.

data.title: Azure Functions - RAG Pattern

data.text: RAG combines the best of both worlds: **Azure AI Search** finds relevant information, and **Azure OpenAI** generates natural responses. This is more accurate than fine-tuning a model and easier to maintain.
